name: cog-incremental-doctor-watch-sessions
instr:
Cog doctor cannot keep diagnostics current as project files, configuration, environments, and doctor-applied fixes change. Add incremental watch mode without changing non-watch behavior.

The `github.com/replicate/cog/pkg/doctor` package must expose `InputKind`, `WatchInput`, `Check.Inputs`, `WatchEvent`, `ChangeSource`, `WatchOptions`, `WatchDelta`, `WatchSnapshot`, `WatchSession`, `NewWatchSession`, `WatchSession.Next`, and `WatchSession.Close`. `InputKind` has exactly `InputFile`, `InputDockerEnvironment`, `InputPythonEnvironment`, and `InputGPUEnvironment`, with `InputFile` assigned by `iota`. Each registered check must report normalized dependencies deterministically, omitting referenced Python paths unavailable from the current project context.

Initially publish every supplied check in canonical registry order, including checks without findings. Coalesce pending events. For each relevant event, refresh changed declared inputs from their current sources and rerun exactly their declaring checks, retaining unaffected results. Irrelevant events produce no generation.

Each completed generation must atomically describe one post-event project state. Order results and added, changed, and removed deltas canonically. A successful fixer filesystem change produces exactly one reconciled generation from its resulting state, including downstream checks; renamed paths replace obsolete dependencies. Publish failed fixes as errors without blocking later external changes.
